rules.reason: Local plans and operation notes; exclude from Git and general cleanup
Permanent GitHub platform history; no general cleanup or automatic expiration
Incoming collaborator archives awaiting import; never clean automatically
Retained originals and receipts of completed imports; never clean automatically
Independent closed records may be deleted individually; pending and incoming originals are protected from broad cleanup
Disposable runtime data; recent jobs limited to 10 and 100 MiB, browser profile cleaned on exit; user may clear the whole directory while stopped
Release archives; Git ignore is not a deletion policy
Historical acceptance report and comparison data
Generated fixtures and protected acceptance data share this root
Rebuildable cache and build stages; retained evidence lives in evidence-archive
Upstream runtime downloads; costly to fetch again
Active and interrupted evidence, imports, diagnostics and recording locks; never clean automatically
Legacy location protected until verified migration; do not create new records here
